header.privacy: All dwelling positions below are invention. No household names, individual historical mark positions, scan pixels or local paths are retained.
header.ground: Raw spacing <=4 m on every tested footprint; finest baked ground and drawn triangles, checked at 0.5 m intervals.

tradePolicy.surface: production Terrain.heightAt, exag=1; 0.5 m footprint grid including edges
tradePolicy.side: same side of the original nearest road; no road or stream centreline crossed
tradePolicy.water: all seven PR70 water trades retain method=water and a real bank attachment; otherwise keep the original bank and cap the visible foundation
